text:
infra-monitor-bot: ALERT: paging pipeline errors detected for team `infra` (unacked). 127 failures to PagerDuty in the last 5m. error=webhook_timeout; rate=high :rotating_light:

olivia: seeing this now, I'm oncall. Are pages actually not going out or just not acking?

tom: looks like the alert-router health checks show heartbeats to pagerbridge failing since 1927654200. suspect route config. pulling logs.

raj: +1, checking deploys — no deploys in last 2h. Could be credential rotation. grabbing router logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z router ERROR send_page failed id=abc123 ctx=pagerbridge timeout=30s
2026-03-15T14:12:10Z router WARN retry 1/3 endpoint=https://pd-webhook.internal/503
2026-03-15T14:13:05Z router ERROR webhook response=502 body="upstream reset"
```

emily: customer support is getting multiple inbound chats about delayed alerts. Do we know if outgoing phone pages are affected?

olivia: yes, customers confirm missed phone pages for some accounts. This is impacting Dedicated customers with PD integration. tagging @oncall-rotation to escalate. :grimacing: 

oncall-rotation: Received. I'm jumping in to coordinate on-call handoff. Can someone try a manual curl to the PD endpoint from the router host?

raj: ran quick curl from router host: `curl -vS -m 10 https://pd-webhook.internal/health` -> connection reset, TLS handshake completes but upstream resets. Suspect upstream lb or pd-proxy.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty API: All systems operational (https://status.pagerduty.com) — no incidents reported.

tom: so PD is green. Means internal proxy or our alert-router -> pagerbridge link. I'm going to flip alert-router to fallback webhook (legacy endpoint) for infra to restore pages. Will post rollback plan.

olivia: please do. Also let's triage blast radius and notify affected customers. Emily, can you gather impacted customer list from billing tags `pd-integration=true`?

emily: on it. already pulling. ETA 10m.

raj: patch ready: changing route for service infra -> https://pd-legacy.internal/webhook; updating retry backoff and lowering concurrent connections. Applying now: `kubectl apply -f alert-router-route-infra.yaml`

infra-monitor-bot: ACTION: route update scheduled by raj at 1927654505.

olivia: after patch, I see new ack events coming in. Pages are flowing again. can folks confirm phone pages are hitting customers?

emily: customers in the affected list are reporting pages received. I'll open a support broadcast for those with SLA impact.

tom: logging shows errors drop to zero after route switch. Keeping legacy route for 30m to ensure stability, then we'll revert once upstream is healthy.

raj: nod. Investigating why proxy returned resets. Opening ticket with infra-proxy team and attaching tcpdumps. suspect MTU or upstream firewall rule got applied during morning maint window.

olivia: good. For immediate mitigation: 1) fallback route enabled, 2) support notif created, 3) oncall handoff remains with olivia until 16:00 UTC. Who will own follow-up?

tom: I'll own the post-incident debug and steps to harden alert-router (circuit breaker + alert on webhook reset rate).

raj: I'll work with infra-proxy to validate firewall rules and run canary traffic through primary path.

emily: I'll follow up with affected customers and log incident impact in the support tracker (ref: SUP-1972).

olivia: plan sounds good. quick note: let's make sure incident-bot paging suppression thresholds didn't swallow any other alerts during the outage. tom, can you check suppression logs?

tom: suppression checks look normal, we had no global suppression flip. The failures were outbound webhook errors, not suppression.

infra-monitor-bot: NOTE: created incident record INC-2026-0315-1 and assigned severity P2.

olivia: ok closing the live thread. we'll keep the fallback until raj confirms primary path healthy and we have a rollback plan. postmortem to be drafted in 48h; assign tom as author. thanks all. :thumbsup:
